tajweed application (qaws-net/tajweed), table `tajweed_rules` only. It contains
rule patterns and nothing else: no user data, no credentials, no reader activity.
This is the legacy rule table AS DEPLOYED - what the PHP engine actually ran
with, which is NOT the same as the authored workbook. Use
EIGHT RULES DIFFER FROM THE WORKBOOK, listed in full under differsFromWorkbook
below. Each was hand-edited in the database in February 2026 - nine hours to a
day after the workbook was imported - and the workbook was never updated to
match. This corpus carries the DATABASE value for all eight, so they are
IS THIS CIRCULAR? For rules 1-172 before 2026-08-18, no: they predate this
engine entirely. Seven rows WERE written by us on 2026-08-18 (three tahhan,
four madd) and are reverted here to their pre-our-write workbook value, which is
what the legacy engine ran with; revertedToSpreadsheet names them. Rules 175-182
are ours entirely and are absent. The `tajweed_ayah_spans` table IS downstream
of us - 147,255 rows, exactly our published span count - and is never used here.
